_comment: Copy to config/checks.json, which is git-ignored. The list of estate hostnames to probe is NOT here — it is derived from data/servers.json, so a site deployed today is checked today. This file holds only what cannot be derived: where to send the report, pages the estate does not host, and which forms may be submitted.

webhookHeaders._comment: Optional. If the n8n webhook uses header auth, put it here. This file is git-ignored, so a token is safe — but it never reaches data/ or the dashboard.

_notify_todo: Proving it end to end first, so only one inbox gets the noise. Add mdo60@kwgroup.in and mm3@kwgroup.in to `notify` once a real report has arrived.
_extra_comment: Pages the estate does not serve, so nothing can discover them. The ad landing pages live on domains none of the three boxes has heard of — and they are where the leads come from, which makes them the pages that most need watching. Labelled by host + path so a failure names the page, not just the domain.
_forms_comment: A form is submitted ONLY if it appears here. Every run posts a real lead into a real CRM, so each entry is a deliberate decision. All sixteen landing pages post to the same submit.php per domain, so two entries cover them — probing all sixteen pages above is what catches an individual page being down. `fields` maps the page's real field names to the placeholders name/email/phone/message; any other value is sent literally. `expect` is a string the response must contain, because a submit.php that returns 200 and drops the lead is exactly the failure worth catching.

forms._verify_comment: No API key on disk. It asks n8n — which already holds the Cratio credential — over LOOPBACK, so the request never leaves the box and there is nothing here worth stealing. Import deploy/n8n-kw-lead-verify.json, point its HTTP node at Cratio, activate it. `match` is LEAD_FOUND rather than the email itself: a not-found reply that echoed the address back would read as a hit, which is the one failure mode that must never be silent. Delete this whole `verify` block to go back to 'the page accepted it'.
